title: Designing Google Docs

facts.text: Clients send document editing operations to the WebSocket server, which handles the real-time communication.
Document operations are persisted in a message queue.
The file operation server consumes the operations that clients produce and generates transformed operations using collaboration algorithms.
Three types of data are stored: file metadata, file content and operations.
One of the biggest challenges is real-time conflict resolution.
Common conflict-resolution algorithms include operational transformation (OT), differential synchronization (DS) and conflict-free replicated data type (CRDT).
The guide says Google Docs uses OT according to its Wikipedia page, and that CRDT is an active area of research for real-time concurrent editing.

notes: thin: the guide has about eleven sentences; no requirements, scale or estimates, data model, API, or explanation of how OT, DS or CRDT resolve a conflict.
